sourceNote: Printed page 37: a full-page map titled “نقشہ: مکہ اور مدینہ کے درمیان راستہ” showing the routes between Makkah (مکۃ المکرمۃ) and Madinah (المدینۃ المنورۃ) with the place names Uhud, Dhu al-Hulayfah, Abwa, Rabigh, Khulays, Usfan, Hudaybiyyah, Jabal Arafat, Taif and a compass arrow. It is redrawn only as a schematic route map with the legible names; the smaller names and the coastline are not reproduced. A column of fragmentary letters at the right edge (from the cropped back of the previous page) is excluded. English and Pashto are our translations (need native review); watermark, handwriting, page-edge shadows, a thumb at the page edge and ornamental borders excluded. Scan n = printed page n+1; the files of this stretch are out of pair order: printed 36 = 019_page_2, 37 = 019_page_1, 38 = 018_page_2, 39 = 018_page_1, 40 = 020_page_2, 41 = 020_page_1.
